channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Netanyahu confirms Egyptian intelligence chief visited Israel before October 7
item.description: Netanyahu confirms Egypt's intelligence chief visited Israel before October 7 but denies meeting him: "I want to know the truth. There are cameras."

item.title: Threat cleared: Delta flight departs New York for Tel Aviv
item.description:
A Delta Air Lines flight delayed in New York following a bomb threat was cleared for takeoff to Tel Aviv after security checks were completed.
The threat was determined to be a hoax, marking the second false bomb threat made by a prankster since Tuesday morning.

item.title: Defense Minister: Iran attempting to influence Israeli elections
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz warns that Iran and its proxies are attempting to carry out terrorist attacks aimed at influencing the outcome of Israel's elections.

item.title: Hezbollah's weaponry harms civilians on both sides of the border
item.description: Northern Israel and Southern Lebanon are littered with the remnants of war, shrapnel, rocket components, and unexploded ordnance (UXOs) from Hezbollah's attacks. Op-ed.

item.description: Zvi Yehezkeli believes Tehran is presenting plans for a possible escalation ahead of the US midterm elections and even threatening a ground invasion of the UAE.

item.title: A container ship was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz for the second time in a day
item.description: The British Maritime Trade Center reported an attack on a container ship in the Strait of Hormuz. This is the second attack on a container ship in the Strait within a day, along with attacks on tankers.

item.title: Rabbi David Stav: 'We abandoned Judaism'
item.description: The chairman of the Tzohar rabbinical organization argues that the achievements of the Judea and Samaria enterprise came at the cost of concessions on religion-and-state issues and handing control of religious institutions to the haredi community.

item.title: Ben Gvir demands death penalty for murderer of Netanel Shakron
item.description: Ben Gvir demands death penalty for murderer of Netanel Shakron

item.title: Special interview with Iran’s chief rabbi
item.description: In an interview with an Iranian television channel, Rabbi Younes Hamami Lalehzar claimed that synagogues in Iran do not require special security, while also criticizing Israel.

item.title: Ban on appointing ILA chief: Smotrich slams High Court, calls ruling a 'legal injustice'
item.description: Smotrich slammed the High Court for delaying Yehuda Eliyahu’s appointment as Israel Land Authority director-general until after the elections, vowing to remove 'extremist elements' from the judicial system.

item.title: Join the Livestream: Torah MiTzion turns 30
item.description: The leading Torah-Zionist mission movement, which has established dozens of Batei Midrash and Kollels worldwide, will mark 30 years of activity with a festive tribute evening. The event will bring together hundreds of emissaries (shlichim), alumni, and community leaders from Israel and abroad.

item.title: During visit to Seam Line, Netanyahu warns terrorists: 'Don't test us'
item.description: The Prime Minister visited the seam line in Samaria alongside senior security officials and declared that the IDF is prepared for a scenario in which PA security forces turn their weapons against Israel.

item.title: Trump on if he'll endorse candidate in Israel: 'Maybe I'll do something'
item.description: US President Donald Trump responded to the question of whether he would recommend a candidate in the Israeli elections: "Maybe we'll do something."

item.title: Former hostage: 'I am still recovering'
item.description: Former hostage Segev Kalfon marks one year since release, reflects on 738 days in captivity: 'Still learning to live again.'

item.title: Three hours in the air, 200 bullets: Israel Aerospace Industries’ new weapons system
item.description: Israel Aerospace Industries and SIG Sauer complete a live-fire test of the FIRE STORM 250 system, which integrates an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) with an M250 machine gun, while maintaining human control over engagement decisions.

item.title: 9-month-old baby critically injured after falling from slide
item.description: A nine-month-old baby fell from a slide while playing.

item.title: Saada calls for PM indictment withdrawn, former law enforcement officials investigated
item.description: MK Moshe Saada calls for appointing a new attorney general after the elections to withdraw the indictment against Netanyahu and launch investigations alleging serious misconduct in the investigations.

item.title: Heated confrontation over UN's silence on Hamas crimes
item.description: Israeli Ambassador Danny Danon confronted UN representative Vanessa Frazier over a report on children in armed conflict that he said ignores Hamas. "But you stay silent."

item.title: France will soon call out the army to stop the barbarians
item.description: At this moment there is nothing more important in Europe, nothing more indicative of its future, than what is happening in France. Opinion.

item.title: Following security threats: Israel to ban certain types of drones
item.description: Defense Minister Israel Katz is expected to sign an order on Sunday banning the operation of fiber-optic and SIM-controlled drones for six months, following security threats.

item.title: ISIS attack plot against IDF soldiers in Jerusalem foiled
item.description: 18-year-old Umm al-Fahm resident arrested on suspicion of pledging allegiance to ISIS and planning an attack on IDF soldiers in Jerusalem’s Old City.

item.title: Ramim Ridge tragedy: Injured by shrapnel, teen saves friends on school trip
item.description: Fifteen-year-old Yair was injured in the unexploded ordnance blast on the Ramim Ridge but rushed to treat his friends.

item.title: Teen detained over racist attack on Druze woman aboard bus
item.description: Police question 15-year-old girl suspected of throwing socks, shouting insults at Druze woman speaking Arabic on a bus.

item.title: Yesha Council launches situation room to combat fake news about Judea and Samaria
item.description: JSR information center to provide real-time reports, footage, and analysis, aiming to counter misinformation and provide accurate information to audiences worldwide.

item.title: From Mexico to Australia: Eight Jewish educators honored at global conference in Israel
item.description: President Herzog and Minister Chikli attend inaugural Global Jewish Teacher Award ceremony, recognizing educators for contributions to Jewish identity and strengthening ties with Israel.
